note: Definitions written once per database by the model, frozen as a benchmark input. They are pinned because regenerating them on every run made the definition-dependent arms a joint measurement of prompt and definitions: two runs with identical prompts produced different text for 6 of 11 databases and moved `synth-definitions` by 5.1pp. Regenerate with BIRD_DEFINITIONS_FORCE=1 and commit the result if the prompt or model changes.

definitions.superhero:
- alignment.alignment: Moral orientation of the character; N/A means alignment is unknown or not applicable.
- attribute.attribute_name: Rated capability category scored in hero_attribute.attribute_value.
- hero_attribute.attribute_value: Rating from 5 to 100 for the hero on the given attribute; higher is stronger.
- superhero.height_cm: Character height in centimetres; 0 indicates unknown.
- superhero.weight_kg: Character weight in kilograms; 0 indicates unknown.
- superhero.full_name: Character's real or full name, as opposed to superhero_name.
- publisher.publisher_name: Company or rights holder that publishes the character; blank means unknown.
- colour.colour: Colour name used for eye, hair, or skin colour; No Colour means none.
- gender.gender: Character gender; N/A means unknown or not applicable.
- superpower.power_name: Name of a distinct superpower a hero may possess via hero_power.
definitions.california_schools:
- "Academic Year" is the school year the FRPM counts describe.
- "District Code" identifies the district within its county.
- "School Code" identifies the school within its district.
- "NSLP Provision Status" indicates which federal school meal provision the school operates under.
- "Charter School (Y/N)" is 1 if the school is a charter school, 0 otherwise.
- IRC is 1 if the school is in a school district that is also an Indian reservation or has Indian lands, 0 otherwise.
- "Enrollment (K-12)" is the count of students in kindergarten through grade 12.
- "Free Meal Count (K-12)" is the number of K-12 students eligible for free meals.
- "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" is the free meal count divided by K-12 enrollment.
- "FRPM Count (K-12)" is the number of K-12 students eligible for free or reduced-price meals.
- "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" is the FRPM count divided by K-12 enrollment.
- "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" is the count of students aged 5 through 17.
- "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" is the number of students aged 5-17 eligible for free meals.
- "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" is the free meal count for ages 5-17 divided by enrollment for ages 5-17.
definitions.student_club:
- budget.spent is the total amount actually spent against a budget category for an event.
- budget.remaining is the unspent balance of the budget amount, which can be negative when spending exceeds the allocation.
- budget.amount is the total funds allocated to a budget category for an event.
- budget.event_status reflects the planning stage of the linked event (Open, Closed, Planning).
- event.event_date is the scheduled start date and time of the event.
- event.type classifies the event by its purpose or format.
- event.status indicates whether the event is still open, closed, or in planning.
- expense.approved indicates whether the expense has been approved for reimbursement.
- expense.cost is the amount charged for a single expense line.
- income.amount is the money received from a given source.
- income.source identifies where the income came from (dues, fundraising, school appropriation, sponsorship).
- member.position is the member's role or standing in the organization; Inactive marks members no longer active.
- zip_code.type distinguishes standard delivery addresses from PO Box and unique (single-address) ZIP codes.
definitions.thrombosis_prediction:
- Examination Date is the date the examination was performed.
- aCL IgG, aCL IgM, and aCL IgA are anticardiolipin antibody isotype measurements.
- ANA is the antinuclear antibody titer.
- ANA Pattern lists observed nuclear staining patterns.
- Diagnosis records the clinical diagnosis assigned at examination.
- KCT, RVVT, and LAC are lupus anticoagulant-related test results, with + indicating positive.
- Symptoms records clinical manifestations present at examination.
- Thrombosis counts thrombotic events.
- Patient SEX is recorded sex.
- Birthday is the patient's date of birth.
- Description is a patient-related date.
- First Date is the patient's first recorded date.
- Admission indicates admission status, with + meaning admitted.
- Laboratory Date is the date laboratory specimens were collected.
- U-PRO is urine protein result.
- CRP, RA, and RF are qualitative or semi-quantitative inflammatory/autoimmune results.
- RNP, SM, SC170, SSA, SSB, and CENTROMEA are autoantibody results.
- DNA-II is an anti-double-stranded DNA measurement.
definitions.toxicology:
- atom.element is the chemical element symbol of the atom, lowercase.
- bond.bond_type is the bond order: "-" single, "=" double, "#" triple.
- connected links two atoms joined by a bond; each bond appears in both directions.
- molecule.label is the molecule's charge class: "+" for positively charged, "-" for negatively charged.
definitions.debit_card_specializing:
- customers.Segment classifies accounts as SME, LAM, or KAM.
- customers.Currency is the billing currency of the customer.
- gasstations.ChainID identifies the retail chain the station belongs to.
- gasstations.Country is the country where the station operates.
- gasstations.Segment is the station's market positioning category.
- transactions_1k.Date is the calendar day of the fuel purchase.
- transactions_1k.Amount is the quantity of product purchased.
- transactions_1k.Price is the total amount paid for the transaction.
- yearmonth.Date is the year and month (YYYYMM) of the consumption record.
- yearmonth.Consumption is the customer's total monthly consumption; negative values indicate corrections or reversals.
definitions.financial:
- account.frequency: statement issuance cadence; POPLATEK MESICNE monthly, TYDNE weekly, PO OBRATU per transaction.
- account.date: date the account was opened.
- card.issued: date the card was issued.
- client.birth_date: client's date of birth.
- disp.type: role on the account; OWNER holds the account, DISPONENT is an authorized signatory.
- district.A2: district name.
- district.A3: region the district belongs to.
- district.A4: number of inhabitants in the district.
- district.A5: number of municipalities with fewer than 500 inhabitants.
- district.A6: number of municipalities with 500 to 1999 inhabitants.
- district.A7: number of municipalities with 2000 to 9999 inhabitants.
- district.A8: number of municipalities with 10000 or more inhabitants.
- district.A9: number of cities.
- district.A10: ratio of urban inhabitants to total inhabitants, in percent.
- district.A11: average salary in the district.
- district.A12: unemployment rate in the district, in percent.
- district.A13: number of entrepreneurs per 1000 inhabitants.
- district.A14: number of crimes committed in the district.
- district.A15: number of crimes committed in the district in 1995.
definitions.formula_1:
- circuits.lat/lng: geographic coordinates of the circuit, in decimal degrees.
- circuits.alt: circuit altitude; NULL when unknown.
- constructorResults.points: championship points awarded to the constructor for that race.
- constructorResults.status: constructor's race outcome code (e.g. D for disqualified).
- constructorStandings.points: cumulative constructor points after the given race.
- constructorStandings.position: constructor's championship standing after the given race.
- constructorStandings.wins: cumulative race wins by the constructor up to the given race.
- driverStandings.points: cumulative driver points after the given race.
- driverStandings.position: driver's championship standing after the given race.
- driverStandings.wins: cumulative race wins by the driver up to the given race.
- drivers.number: driver's permanent car number; NULL if none assigned.
- drivers.dob: driver's date of birth.
- lapTimes.lap: lap number within the race.
- lapTimes.position: driver's track position on that lap.
- lapTimes.milliseconds: lap duration in milliseconds.
- pitStops.stop: sequential pit stop number for the driver in that race.
definitions.card_games:
- cards.availability lists the platforms where the card is playable, such as paper, MTGO, Arena, or Shandalar.
- cards.borderColor indicates the card frame's border style, with borderless meaning no printed border.
- cards.colorIndicator lists colors shown by an indicator when the card has no mana cost.
- cards.convertedManaCost is the total mana value of the card, with 1000000 marking a variable cost.
- cards.duelDeck identifies which half of a Duel Deck product the card belongs to.
- cards.edhrecRank is the card's popularity rank on EDHREC, where lower numbers are more popular.
- cards.faceConvertedManaCost is the mana value of this face of a multi-face card.
- cards.flavorName is an alternate in-universe name printed on the card instead of its rules name.
- cards.frameVersion identifies the card frame design era, such as 1993, 1997, 2003, 2015, or future.
- cards.hand is the starting hand modifier for Vanguard cards.
- cards.hasAlternativeDeckLimit indicates the card is allowed as an additional copy beyond normal deck limits.
- cards.hasContentWarning indicates the card carries a content warning.
- cards.hasFoil indicates a foil printing exists.
definitions.european_football_2:
- Player_Attributes.date is the date the player attribute ratings were recorded.
- Player_Attributes.overall_rating is the player's current ability score at that date.
- Player_Attributes.potential is the player's projected maximum ability.
- Player_Attributes.attacking_work_rate and defensive_work_rate describe the player's tactical work-rate tendency; values include non-standard entries (None, norm, y, le, stoc, _0, o, 1, ormal, 2) that should be treated as data-quality variants.
- Player_Attributes.gk_* columns rate goalkeeping-specific abilities and are only meaningful for goalkeepers.
- Player.birthday is the player's date of birth.
- Player.height is in centimeters; Player.weight is in pounds.
- Match.season is the football season label (e.g., 2008/2009).
- Match.stage is the matchday/round number within the season.
- Match.home_team_goal and away_team_goal are goals scored by each side in that match.
- Match.home_player_Xn and home_player_Yn give the pitch coordinates of the home team's nth player; away_player_Xn/Yn likewise for the away team.
- Match.home_player_n and away_player_n identify the nth player (by player_api_id) fielded by each team.
definitions.codebase_community:
- badges.Date is the timestamp the badge was awarded.
- comments.Score is the net vote total on the comment.
- comments.CreationDate is when the comment was posted.
- postHistory.CreationDate is when the revision was recorded.
- postHistory.PostHistoryTypeId identifies the kind of revision event.
- postLinks.CreationDate is when the link between posts was created.
- postLinks.LinkTypeId identifies the kind of relationship between the two posts.
- posts.CreaionDate is when the post was originally created.
- posts.Score is the net vote total on the post.
- posts.ViewCount is the cumulative number of times the post has been viewed.
- posts.LasActivityDate is the most recent time the post saw activity.
- posts.AnswerCount is the number of answers to the question.
- posts.CommentCount is the number of comments on the post.
- posts.FavoriteCount is the number of users who marked the post as a favorite.
- posts.LastEditDate is when the post was most recently edited.
- posts.CommunityOwnedDate is when the post became community-owned.
- posts.ClosedDate is when the post was closed.
- posts.ParentId is the question a post answers.
